author: NASS
description:
I colorized, fully restored, and crafted the sound design for this rare footage documenting daily life in Detroit, Michigan, in the late 1930s. The film captures everyday scenes of the city, including local streets, people, automobiles, service stations, and Briggs Stadium, with details such as 1937 Michigan license plates helping establish its historical period. Preserved as a home movie, this footage offers a fascinating glimpse into ordinary life in Detroit during 1937–1939.

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to 4K quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
✔ Full restoration: stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring made with my own AviSynth and VapourSynth scripts
